source.title: WCA European Championship 2026 Announcement
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Major Championships Team (WMCT) is happy to announce that **Arnhem, The Netherlands** has been selected as the host of the 2026 WCA European Championship.

Speedcubing Nederland, in collaboration with the WMCT, is committed to ensuring that the 2026 WCA European Championship fully reflects the spirit and talent of the European speedcubing community, while providing an exceptional experience for both competitors and spectators.

You can view the application document [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/14o932dpO3BErpxhfNxc0uLL18mNch01V/view?usp=sharing). The Netherlands was the only applicant for this championship.

WMCT is happy to share that applications will soon open for the remaining 2026 Continental Championships and 2027 World Championship.

translation.title: 2026 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛举办地公告
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 大型锦标赛组（WMCT）很高兴宣布，**荷兰阿纳姆**已获选举办 2026 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛。

Speedcubing Nederland 将与 WMCT 合作，让本届欧洲锦标赛充分展现欧洲速拧社区的精神与实力，并为选手和观众带来出色的赛事体验。

申办材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/14o932dpO3BErpxhfNxc0uLL18mNch01V/view?usp=sharing)查看。荷兰是本届赛事唯一的申办方。

WMCT 也很高兴告知大家，其余 2026 年洲际锦标赛及 2027 年世界锦标赛的申办将于近期开放。
